scheme_name: Marriage Assistance to Differently Abled Persons Marrying Differently Abled Persons
other_conditions: Both partners must be differently abled and fall under one of the 21 categories of differently‑abled persons as per Section 2(Zc) of the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016.
Both partners must be above 18 years of age.
If either spouse holds a degree or diploma, the assistance amount is increased.
benefits_summary: Provides ₹25,000 financial assistance (₹12,500 National Savings Certificate + ₹12,500 cheque) for marriage, increased to ₹50,000 (₹25,000 NSC + ₹25,000 cheque) if either spouse has a degree/diploma, along with a certificate of appreciation and an 8‑gram gold coin.
